evidence.name: Screen field: Restore link strikethrough color
evidence.userNeed: Know what "Restore link strikethrough color" controls and when to adjust it while editing a screen.

sections.title: Restore link strikethrough color
sections.description: Colors a line struck through the restore text, but only if you have deliberately added a crossed-out segment to that text. A standard 'Restore Purchases' link has no strikethrough, so leave this alone — it does nothing unless your custom text actually contains a struck-through part.
